name: Taroky Nebraska

Country/Region of Origin: USA (Nebraska), Czech Republic (Bohemian roots). Rules based on variants played around 1900 in the Bohemian Crown (Habsburg Empire). Preserved by Czech-American communities in the American Midwest.
Four active players. A fifth may take part as non-playing dealer who deals to the other four and does not take part in play or scoring for that deal. Play is clockwise, unlike European Taroky.
